title: Push
author: Sapphire
current_text: In August 2022, Push was pulled from Utah's Alpine School District. The Redlands school board voted 3–2 to remove Push from schools after reviewers recommended keeping it with restricted access and the original complainant appealed that decision.

sources.quote: In August of 2022, PUSH was one of 52 books pulled from Utah's Alpine School District.
sources.title: Culture Wars | Sapphire the Author

sources.quote: After a lengthy debate, the board voted to remove Push from all school libraries in a 3-2 vote. Vice President Patty Holohan and board member Melissa Ayala-Quinerto opposed removal.
sources.title: Redlands schools pull Push, tighten rules for Bluest Eye

sources.quote: All three reviewers recommended keeping the book Push with restricted access. None of the reviewers recommended full removal for either title. The original complainant, however, appealed both decisions, sending the books to the board for a public hearing.
sources.title: Redlands schools pull Push, tighten rules for Bluest Eye

sources.quote: The Redlands school board voted 3–2 Tuesday night to remove Push by Sapphire from schools and voted unanimously to restrict access to The Bluest Eye by Toni Morrison.
sources.title: Redlands school board removes 'Push', restricts access to 'The Bluest Eye' | KVCR News
